handoff_commit: Resolve with git log -1 --format=%H -- analysis/re/evidence/restore/room-reconcile/handoff.json; no self-hash embedded.
scope: Only analysis/re/evidence/restore/room-reconcile/**; post-ID helpers and actual room-name mapping writers. Prior setter ranges not re-investigated.
method: Static local analysis, no firmware/device execution, internet, imports, entry creation, annotations or shared changes. retool.py copied closed baseline to new ignored scratch before opening private projects.
entry_validation: All 15 entries already in baseline inventory; bounded entries.json retains exact metadata, selected.json retains callers/instructions/loader-derived file offsets. Validator checks ELF executable mappings and every instruction. No guessed entries or boundary recovery required.

supported_claims.claim: Post-ID helpers called in order at 0x133090/0x13309c/0x1330a6 perform coordinate/predicate-dependent neighborhood processing. Selected writes propagate nonzero low-six-bit IDs with 0x40; do not establish promotion or global ID stability. Radius/bounds/seed influence output even at fixed dimensions.

AppProxy 0x3c194 filters out listed IDs while retaining other old names and IDs; 0x3c2a0 copies ordered 24-byte name fields and substitutes sequential response IDs, then calls SetRoomIdMapping. 0x670dc calls the latter only on its matching pending name-operation result and nonzero status. Not proof of automatic reconciliation on arbitrary edited grid load.

Inference: fixed dimensions/checksum do not guarantee overlap, seed connectivity, final ID or ordered name/ID correspondence. Preserve coherent metadata/unknown bytes; no semantic edit or restore safety certification.

validation_commands.summary: 2 binary SHA256s; 15 existing entries, 3707 instruction records, 531 claim anchors and 2 float literals against original ELF; C/selected/entry hashes.
5 host provenance tests; reject non-ELF, non-executable/cross-boundary mappings, altered C and selected entry.
Fresh private baseline copy; sequential exports of both programs; all 15 C and complete selected metadata identical. Logs/private invocation argv remain ignored.
Lane-local generated-C whitespace policy; generated bytes unmodified.

checker_changes: New lane-local checker/tests only; no encountered checker bug or shared fix.
limits: No proof of final 1..15-to-16..31 promotion; complete postprocessor closure not traced.
No proven dataflow from navigation regeneration response to AppProxy returned IDs/pending ordered names; no automatic regeneration after RRSLAM edit/load.
Virtual coordinate predicates/XY conversion implementation, 0x12d884 fallback and callbacks reached through 0x12c860 remain unexpanded.
Opaque regions 6/13/14 not directly classified; no claim they are independent.
24-byte checked C-string copies and fixed allocations are not malformed-input/name ABI safety proof.
Replay and original-byte equality do not prove semantic/runtime safety, snapshot consistency, quiescence, cache freshness or durability.
